comparison.objective: Trace a 45-degree line with a cross-slide by coordinating two feeds versus tune a shock absorber from observed stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous bimanual handwheel coordination in one steady pass versus stabilize, insert a hex key, unlock, finely rotate, relock, and iteratively test.
comparison.success_condition: Pointer must travel start-to-end along the scribed line in one pass; candidate requires two safe cycles under explicit dynamic and retention limits.
comparison.reason: Both use controlled rotation, but cross-slide trajectory coordination does not test tool-mediated locking or dynamic calibration. Path-error thresholds are absent.
